name: Innocent Forest2 -Sora no Shindai-
source:
The forest of lost memories: A doctor named Hauser, just moved into the town. While he takes a walk in the town, he steps into the forest and then meets a girl, Luclei, in the sudden washing rain. Luclei catches a cold by walking in the rain. Hauser has been afraid of facing a patient from his memory of a girl he couldn’t save, but he regains his lost memory with the girl as he nurses Luclei... 

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929180/Innocent_Forest_2_The_Bed_in_the_Sky/] Steam[/url]]

A virtual reality adaptation of a short story from the "[url=http://lucray.cocotte.jp/inst/]Innocent Forest[/url]" series written by Yomino Machiko. "Sora no Shindai" corresponds to the 7th episode published in the 2nd volume.
translation:
失忆之森中，医生豪泽刚搬到小镇。他在镇上散步时走进森林，突然遇上倾盆大雨中的少女露克莱。露克莱因淋雨而感冒。由于记忆中有个没能救活的女孩，豪泽一直害怕面对病人；但在照料露克莱的过程中，他重新找回了关于那个女孩的记忆……

本作是由咏野万知子创作的《无垢森林》系列短篇小说改编的虚拟现实作品。《天空之床》对应第二卷出版的第七集。

[改编自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/929180/Innocent_Forest_2_The_Bed_in_the_Sky/]Steam[/url]及[url=http://lucray.cocotte.jp/inst/]《无垢森林》系列[/url]]
